title: Hover-expand CSS for table cells is centralized in getActiveCellSelector
answers: Where is hover-to-expand behavior implemented for table cells?
How do I add a new cell type that expands on hover like AutoCell?
Why does hover expansion not work in Safari?
body:
The selector that lets an overflowing table cell expand (on hover and/or when selected) is built once in packages/grafana-ui/src/components/Table/TableNG/styles.ts:getActiveCellSelector and consumed by every cell renderer that supports overflow: AutoCell (packages/grafana-ui/src/components/Table/TableNG/Cells/AutoCell.tsx:buildAutoCellStyles), PillCell (packages/grafana-ui/src/components/Table/TableNG/Cells/PillCell.tsx:getStyles), SummaryCell (packages/grafana-ui/src/components/Table/TableNG/components/SummaryCell.tsx), and the generic getDefaultCellStyles/getMaxHeightCellStyles.
getActiveCellSelector(isNested, hoverOverflow) omits the `:hover` branch when hoverOverflow is false or when IS_SAFARI_26 is true, but always keeps the `aria-selected` (click-to-expand) branch.
Any new cell renderer that wants hover-to-expand behavior must route through this helper (passing hoverOverflow from TableCellStyleOptions) instead of hand-rolling a hover selector, to stay consistent with the hoverOverflow option and the Safari 26 workaround.
applies: packages/grafana-ui/src/components/Table/TableNG cell renderers and shared cell styles
